h3: Introduction Adult nursing Course BSc for Postgraduate

content: The overall aim of this program is to provide our students with all the skills, knowledge and attributes needed to meet the challenges of what comes into the professional life of a nurse in the continuously changing healthcare needs and to flourish in the modern health Service. The degree offers lifelong learning and career opportunities for the students as well as a strong emphasis on leadership in nursing. Alongside practical experience, you will gain important theoretical knowledge. The cohorts are limited, and this aids in ensuring that our students receive the resources they need to get the most out of the program. Throughout the years of studies, you will be equipped with extensive clinical experience in different settings, like clinics, hospital wards, critical care, community settings, and palliative care.

Nursing is a very competitive study field, and it is necessary not only to demonstrate academic excellence when applying but also to have a passion for such a challenging task. In high-pressure environments, students must have excellent literacy and numeracy skills, be great communicators and be able to function as part of a team. International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 30 points A-level Requirement: ABB Motivational letter IELTS requirement: 7.0 overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module.

title: Undergraduate Ancient History - Study in UK – Global Group of Education
meta_description: Graduates can value their bachelor degree through analytic, research and communication skills that they developed throughout their studies.

h3: Introduction to undergraduate course Ancient History

content: The BA Degree for Ancient History explores a wide range of diverse eras, cultures, and countries. You can choose from the topics which suit your area of interest – from the early period of Greece to Rome and beyond that, the influence of Classics on contemporary history and current affairs. The course also covers a wide geographical area, from the Black Sea to Roman Britain, Egypt, Persia, and North Africa. While focusing on historical modules, you will also get the opportunity to learn Greek and/or Latin and study areas of art, literature, and philosophy.

The degree provides you with arduous training experience, thus producing graduates with an extraordinary breadth of knowledge. They are suitable for many careers in fields as diverse as heritage management, journalism, law, civil service, business, teaching, IT and tourism. They can also undertake further studies and research degrees and can gain employment in major museums and universities locally, and internationally. Graduates can value their bachelor's degree through analytic, research and communication skills that they developed throughout their studies. They can utilize their degree in the following areas of the profession: 1.    Heritage manager 2.    Gallery/museum manager 3.    Archivist 4.    Academic researcher 5.    Historic building inspector 6.    Conversation officer 7.    Museum education officer The average salary of a historian can range from £20,000 annually.

The fees may vary depending on the course and institution generally; the tuition fees for an international BA full-time degree is £19,000 per annum. All entry fees will be annually reviewed and can be subjected as an increase in the fee are also likely to rise (fees are usually set for international students, for the period of the entry year). International students will be required to pay a deposit of £1,000 on their tuition fees before a certificate of acceptance for studies is provided. This fee will only be refunded if permission to immigrate is rejected.

Universities in the UK is well known for expanding easier access to higher education even for international students. They provide a range of scholarships to support talented and needy students from all backgrounds.

•    International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 35 points (includes 6, 6, 5. Total point of 35 points also includes TOK/EE) •    A-level Requirement: AAB •    IELTS requirement: 6.5 bands overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module •    TOEFL requirement: 92 points overall with a minimum of 22 in reading, 21 in listening, 23 in speaking and 23 in writing.

h3: Introduction to Foundation Course  Anthropology for undergraduate (BA Hons)

content: Anthropology is the study of human societies and social sciences. It teaches us the differences between people from all over the world and what we can learn from their lives. A degree in Anthropology builds your skills and knowledge on diverse cultural backgrounds and the way of life of other people and the structuring of society. Study areas such as literature, linguistics, and history are heavily involved in creating theories and lines of the reason that will help a student understand the broad range of ways people around the world live in. The skills and knowledge with which you are going to graduate will help you evaluate the organization and social life so you can think outside the box. Anthropology modules include economics and money, power and politics, environmental impact, faith, health, race and cross-cultural efficiency. Knowledge in cultural studies, geography, languages and internationally handled relations will help formulate a student for an anthropology degree. Anthropology courses include fully equipped modern facilities, access to archaeological artefacts, researchers with a wide range of experience, research elements under strict examination to demonstrate cutting-edge scientific achievements and opportunity to contribute your knowledge to the job market.

The exclusive set of skills that an Anthropology degree ensures that students pursue careers in science, education, media, policy, and non-profit organizations. Their average salary starts from £17,063 for non-professional and £20,000 for professionals individuals.

The department is a highly respected centre of excellence in teaching and research by academics and employers, which also represents the high interest of prospective students of different nationalities. Entry requirements for Anthropology programmes can vary depending on the university and the course you want to join. If you are applying for a degree in Anthropology, you do not need to have previous education in the following, but the grades also play a substantial role in your intended field of study. title: Architecture Postgraduate- Study in UK – Global Group of Education
meta_description: Architecture Postgraduate courses at UK universities concentrate on the subject's technology, design, cultural and historical aspects, and lectures will be based on history and theory.

h3: Introduction to Postgraduate courses for Architecture

content: Architecture courses at UK universities concentrate on the subject's technology, design, cultural and historical aspects, and lectures will be based on history and theory; it will be held alongside 3D and art design. It offers students the best approach to learning about any part of their career. Becoming a fully qualified architect takes a period of seven years, including five years of study with two years of technical training and practical practice before you appear in the final exams. After the initial undergraduate degree of 3-year, graduates will affiliates with RIBA, the Royal College of British Architects, before enrolling in a BArch, Diploma, or March degree. For prospective students to become architects, it takes patience, hard work, and commitment, but the rewards are massive.

Graduates will find positions in architectural design, engineering and building, preservation, and urban planning after completing the seven years of study needed to become a registered architect. They can find career paths in one of the following areas: •    Building architectural designers •    Structural architects •    Building planners •    Building architects •    Building designers Their average salary can start from £20,000 for professionals and £16,640 for non-professional per annum.

English, mathematics, and art and design are all prerequisite subjects to learn before applying to an architecture program, and you should also know the basics of freehand drawing and skill in designing and creating 3D work is also needed. A portfolio of research is needed to be considered for admission at several Universities in the UK. Entry requirements can vary depending on the university and the course you want to opt for. Here are some other requirements needed: International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 32 points A-level Requirement: AAB with skills of science, art and writing ability IELTS requirement: 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module TOEFL requirement: 92 points overall with a minimum of 22 in reading, 21 in listening, 23 in speaking, and 23 in writing.

The fees may vary conditional to the course and institution; the tuition fees for a full-time international degree is £21,200 per annum. All entry fees will be annually reviewed and can be subjected as an increase in the fee are also likely to rise (fees are usually set for international students, for the period of the entry year). International students will be required to pay a deposit of £1,000 on their tuition fees before a certificate of acceptance for studies is provided. This fee will only be refunded if permission to immigrate is rejected.

Universities in the UK are well known for increasing easier access to higher education even for international students. They provide a variety of scholarships to support brilliant and needy students from all backgrounds.

title: Arts French Undergraduate- Study in UK – Global Group of Education
meta_description: Studying Undergraduate French and History of Art allows us to understand the world we now live in and to shed light on the past.

h3: Introduction to the undergraduate course for Art French

content: French is a popular language throughout the world. Francophone art and philosophy played a central role in the development of our modern society. Studying French and History of Art allows us to understand the world we now live in and to shed light on the past. French and Francophone Studies, as a major subject area, will give you a broad range of courses from the Middle Ages to the 21st century, including professional options taught by leading specialists in their profession. These include several French culture courses–their literature, art, and cinema, but also their political history and philosophical ideas. History of Art will introduce you to the art from various ages and cultures outside the Francophone world. You will learn how the works of art have been made, explore their true meaning, and discover the forms in which they have interpreted.

Arts and humanities research includes an interpretation of human behaviors in a number of cultural contexts and under very specific historical circumstances. Combined with training in critical thinking and communication, the scope of research and the variety of cultural texts and objects studied to make this degree applicable to a wide range of professions, including: 1.    Education 2.    Public administration, civil service, local government, social services, and art institutions 3.    Banking, business, and retail 4.    Charities and campaigning 5.    Advertising, creative industries, journalism, and public relations 6.    Legal workEntry Requirement The department is a highly respected and renowned center of excellence in teaching and research by academics, which also represents the great interest of prospective students of different nationalities. Entry requirements for MA in Art French can vary depending on the university and the course you want to join. If you are applying for this degree, you do not need to have previous education in the following, but the grades also play a substantial role in your intended field of study. Entry requirements can vary depending on the university and the course you want to opt for. Here are some other requirements needed: International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 34 points A-level Requirement: AAB with skills of science, art and writing ability IELTS requirement: 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module

The fees may vary conditional to the course and institution; the tuition fees for a full-time international degree is £19,800 per annum. Please note that in subsequent years of study, the International tuition fee is subject to annual changes in compliance with the university terms and conditions. International students will be expected to pay a £ 1,000 deposit on their tuition fees before an acceptance certificate awarded. The fee can only be refunded if you are refused permission to immigrate.

content: Philosophical learning is valued in just about any industry. It strengthens the persuasion power, problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and communication skills. A study shows that these abilities are in great demand in many careers today that require individuals who can stand back and scrutinize with an open mind. Trips to museums and art galleries help the students produce inspire thoughts about how art is shown and received. By taking part in public art commissions and other activities, you'll gain professional experience. The teaching staff are all internationally renowned artists, curators, and scholars, and will promote frequent exhibits and open debate.

Graduates of Philosophy are working in such varied fields like administration, business development, art and design, community and social services, education, consultancy, entrepreneurship, human resources, healthcare, IT, management, media and many research projects. The average annual salary of a philosopher is £32,500, which can vary depending on the job description.
International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 34 points
A-level Requirement: BBB

Candidates must have studied at least one of the following subjects in their A-levels: Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Studies, Government and Politics, Development Studies, Mathematics, Economic and Social History, Sociology, Anthropology, Philosophy, English language, Religious Studies, English Literature, History, Geography, Classical Civilisation, Archaeology, World Development, Biology, Communication Studies, Environmental Studies, World Development, Chemistry, Modern languages, Physics.
IELTS requirement: 6.5 bands overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module

The Visas and Immigration accommodates international applicant and the EU to show proof of a minimum level of English language proficiency in order to receive a UK visa (Tier 4 visa) for undergraduate or even postgraduate study. This level is referred to as the level of' B2.' In addition, individual institute can request specific levels of English language proficiency needed for their academic courses. Those specifications are likely to be higher than the B2 standard in most cases.
TOEFL requirement: 92 points overall with a minimum of 22 in reading, 21 in listening, 23 in speaking and 23 in writing.

Eligible students are given scholarships and bursaries. About one-third of all our UK undergraduate students will receive grants of up to £ 2,000 per annum, in addition to the government grant program.

Biological Sciences would benefit those who are interested in studying living organisms, whether human or other animals, plants or bacteria because you can choose the modules best suited to your interests; diagnosing and curing disease for conservation and administration of biological resources.

The versatility of this degree scheme is the characteristic feature; graduates can get a splendid opportunity to choose from the entire teaching portfolio provided to create a specific degree that represents their interests.

Life Sciences graduates are in great demand in public sector research agencies, the National Health Service, government departments, the Environment Agency and forensic science. The commercial sectors which actively recruit Life Sciences graduates include the food, pharmaceutical, water, biotechnology, and agricultural industries. Life scientists are also increasingly demanding to contribute to public comprehension of science as journalists and liaison officers, despite the environmental and ethical concerns emerging, for example, from advances in molecular biology and biotechnology.

Whether you're studying human life biology, collaborating with scientists or having an effect on breakthrough technologies, a degree in Chemical engineering will help you affect the world we live in.

As a chemical engineer, you will be responsible for designing and creating a diverse product portfolio. Your research should concentrate on modifying a substance's chemical, biochemical, and physical condition to make it something different, like producing plastic from oil. You will need to understand how to turn raw materials into the appropriate goods while considering health, safety and cost concerns. You can work in diverse fields, including:

Chemistry is a topic that is continually changing and challenges the limits of what is possible in engineering, science and medicine. Whether you're studying human life biology, collaborating with scientists or having an effect on breakthrough technologies, a degree in Chemical engineering will help you affect the world we live in.

As a chemical engineer, you will be responsible for designing and creating a diverse product portfolio. Your research should concentrate on modifying a substance's chemical, biochemical, and physical condition to make it something different, like producing plastic from oil. You will need to understand how to turn raw materials into the appropriate goods while considering health, safety and cost concerns. You can work in diverse fields, including:

Advanced chemical engineering is concerned with groundbreaking new and valuable techniques and materials, such as nanotech, fuel cells and biomedical engineering. The average annual salary of a chemical engineer ranging from £22,000 to £60,500, which can vary depending on the job description.

The course is intended for those interested in learning in the heart of a global city like London, surrounded by some of the UK's biggest buildings and technologically challenging projects. This curriculum is designed for technically skilled construction professionals who want a transition into the construction sector's management positions, oversee large construction projects or set up their own company in an increasingly globalized industry. The course blends business-based modules with build-specific modules to provide a balance of business education that is centered on building. A diploma in construction management will give you a lot of job opportunities, but if you're a motivated student who wants to become an expert, then a UK postgraduate course is the ideal choice for you. These courses offer a diversity of skills and knowledge that helps you to have a deep understanding of the key problems that you will face throughout your career. It will not only help you settle in a highly stable career but will also help you become a highly rated professional.

Construction manager prepare, organize, coordinate and oversee building projects from beginning to finish. They mostly operate from a central office, but also engage with a construction site engineer from a field office, where they track the project and make everyday decisions about construction work. The plan to meet deadlines and answer to emergencies. In addition, they also need several hours of work from construction managers. Construction managers usually have to get a bachelor's degree, and through job training, learn the basic to advance level management techniques. Major construction firms are increasingly seeking candidates with both building experience and a bachelor's degree in any area related to construction. The employment of construction managers is expected to rise by 10% over the next 10 years, greater than the average workers of other occupation. title: Engineering Management - Study in UK – Global Group of Education
meta_description: Engineering Management programs are rising in popularity as the industry familiarizes to the idea of new engineering graduates who are both business and tech-savvy.
content: Engineering Management programs in the United Kingdom are rising in popularity as the industry familiarizes to the idea of new engineering graduates who are both business and tech-savvy. If you have analytical and technical skills and a vision of a big picture with the skill to tackle the challenge on a daily basis, then a career in Engineering Management can be your dream job.

Engineering Management is applying management practice to engineering methodology. A specialized type of management is required to lead engineering workers and ensure the effective execution of projects.

This course will prepare our students for an organization pathway in the engineering industry. The students will research the main areas of project management and operations, which will provide you with the opportunity to use statistical analysis and methods of optimization to solve a variety of problems. You will also grasp an understanding of approaches towards project planning, control, and strategy for operations. There are also opportunities to discover several optional modules that allow you the freedom to build your study path to match your interests.

The requirement of Engineering Management resources is present in many industries. Many managers in engineering work first as engineers, before moving into management roles. Many of the primary responsibilities include project management, testing, and product creation. They serve as managers who devise plans to see a good completion of the projects and handle all staff from various technical backgrounds and cross-disciplinary and regional teams. Their job role includes making sure that the finished product is properly budgeted and sponsored by upper management. Supervisory and recruiting skills are essential to every manager and should be part of a master's degree in engineering management. Also, these skills do not come easily to engineers, but they can be acquired by obtaining a MEM degree. Getting both management skills and engineering skills will significantly increase your chance for success.

Engineering managers will remain in high demand with an increase in public sector infrastructure projects and companies going global. The engineering degree establishes expertise in mathematics, technology, communications and humanities and thus prepares professionals for a range of jobs including Cost Systems Analyst, Construction Management Engineer, Senior Lead Analyst, Engineering Project Manager, Industrial Management Engineer etc.

To meet the entry requirement of this program, you should have at least 60% in your average marks and must have studied prerequisite courses in computer science, physics and mathematics. For postgraduate students, they must have a degree of BE or BSc in engineering or another relevant subject.

International Baccalaureate requirements: Minimum 36 points A-levels requirements: AAB including physics and mathematics International students may require to take the accredited testing system to demonstrate English proficiency. · For IELTS: 7.0 bands overall, with no lower than 6.5 bands in every module. A degree of 2:2 or higher in engineering, science or technology, or similar globally recognized credential.

Applicants should also have these additional requirements: • A comprehensive background in basic mathematics concepts, familiarity with standard calculus concepts, differential equations, linear algebra, and elementary theoretical probability. • Computer programming competence to the level required at the end of the first year of a BSc degree in Computer Science. We also accept and evaluate an individual with professional technical or occupational qualifications.
Based on the educational institute and course, fees vary depending on different factors. The tuition fees for a full-time international Degree range is approximately £26,550 annually.
All entry fees will be subject to be reviewed annually, and an increase in the fee is also likely to occur (fees are usually set for international students, for the period of the entry year).

International candidates will be required to pay £2,000 for the deposit on their tuition fees before a certificate of acceptance for studies is granted. This deposit will be excluded from your tuition fee. This fee will only be refunded if immigrate visa is rejected.

Typically, all students enrolling should be able to complete their program without encountering any extra study costs apart from their tuition fee. On the time of registration, any unavoidable additional mandatory costs costing more than 1% of the annual undergraduate fee, will be made clear to you.

If you have analytical and technical skills and a vision of a big picture with the skill to tackle the challenge on a daily basis, then a career in Engineering Management can be your dream job.

Engineering Management is applying management practice to engineering methodology. A specialized type of management is required to lead engineering workers and ensure the effective execution of projects.

This course will prepare our students for an organization pathway in the engineering industry. The students will research the main areas of project management and operations, which will provide you with the opportunity to use statistical analysis and methods of optimization to solve a variety of problems. You will also grasp an understanding of approaches towards project planning, control, and strategy for operations. There are also opportunities to discover several optional modules that allow you the freedom to build your study path to match your interests.

The requirement of Engineering Management resources is present in many industries. Many managers in engineering work first as engineers, before moving into management roles. Many of the primary responsibilities include project management, testing, and product creation. They serve as managers who devise plans to see a good completion of the projects and handle all staff from various technical backgrounds and cross-disciplinary and regional teams. Their job role includes making sure that the finished product is properly budgeted and sponsored by upper management. Supervisory and recruiting skills are essential to every manager and should be part of a master's degree in engineering management. Also, these skills do not come easily to engineers, but they can be acquired by obtaining a MEM degree. Getting both management skills and engineering skills will significantly increase your chance for success.

Engineering managers will remain in high demand with an increase in public sector infrastructure projects and companies going global. The engineering degree establishes expertise in mathematics, technology, communications and humanities and thus prepares professionals for a range of jobs including Cost Systems Analyst, Construction Management Engineer, Senior Lead Analyst, Engineering Project Manager, Industrial Management Engineer etc.

To meet the entry requirement of this program, you should have at least 60% in your average marks and must have studied prerequisite courses in computer science, physics and mathematics. For postgraduate students, they must have a degree of BE or BSc in engineering or another relevant subject.

The course focuses on the practical, theoretical and therapeutic context of the audiology research, including recognizing, evaluating, rehabilitating and treating adults and children with hearing and vestibular dysfunction. The course includes one brief clinical placement, in a department of NHS audiology or in the independent division to help gain valuable practical experience during your academic studies

Audiologists handle, detect, and treat issues with a patient's vision, balance, or hearing problem. Audiologists employed in health care clinics, such as physicians clinic, laboratories, hospitals etc. Some professionals work in schools with students and move between different facilities. The average salary of a professional audiologist is approximately £58589.2 per annum.

An honours degree minimum Upper Second or the equivalent grades in prerequisite courses are required for the admission. Required experience combined with alternative qualifications may be required for the admission as well as showing a keen interest in audiology. International students may require to take the accredited testing system to demonstrate English proficiency. For IELTS with an overall band of 7.0, including 7.0 bands in the written section For TOEFL with an overall point of 100, including 25 in the written section

title: Public Health postgraduate - Study in the UK – Global Group of Education
meta_description: Public Health postgraduate courses provide students with the skills and knowledge required to contribute to the better health of the population by promoting healthy practices.

h3: Introduction to Public Health course for postgraduate

content: Public Health courses provide students with the set of skills and knowledge required to contribute to the better population health and groups within them by the promotion of healthy practices and prevention of diseases, the change and evaluation of health care practices; and the study and control of environmental risks to human health. Students are trained in the use, development, and critical assessment of conceptual simulations, evidence, approaches of analysis, and applied interventions. Such programs provide them with the skills and knowledge to address varied public health subjects in different income settings.  The varied prospectus allows students to choose from a broad range of expertise or to concentrate on focused areas. The program also offers four alternative paths; the general Public Health and three specialist paths of Environment and Health; Health Services and Health Promotion Management.

Students on this program come from diverse backgrounds. Many are health specialists employed at a service or policy level, while others wish to obtain public health skills that they can apply to their work in development, community services, government, research or teaching.

In public health, the main emphasis is on the health of populations and communities. There are several career options in deep research, government or public services or voluntary bodies and non-governmental organisations.

Beginning from a common core, students may grow into positions that range from health care experts, public health analysts, environmental epidemiologists, disease prevention consultants, health policy advisors or public health directors.
The annual wage of a public health specialist is approximately £78,000
Based on the educational institute and course, fees may change depending on different factors, generally, the tuition fees for a full-time international degree is £21100 annually.
All entry fees will be subject to be reviewed annually and may change without prior notice (fees are usually set for international students, for the period of the entry year).

International applicants will be required to pay an additional of £1,000 as a deposit on their tuition fees before a certificate of acceptance for studies is granted. This fee will only be refunded if an immigrate visa is rejected.

title: Public Health - Study in UK – Global Group of Education
meta_description: Public Health Premaster courses provide students with the skills and knowledge required to contribute to the better health of the population by promoting healthy practices.

h3: Introduction to Public Health course for pre-master

content: Public Health courses provide students with the set of skills and knowledge required to contribute to the better population health and groups within them by the promotion of healthy practices and prevention of diseases, the change and evaluation of health care practices; and the study and control of environmental risks to human health. Students are trained in the use, development, and critical assessment of conceptual simulations, evidence, approaches of analysis, and applied interventions. Such programs provide them with the skills and knowledge to address varied public health subjects in different income settings.  The varied prospectus allows students to choose from a broad range of expertise or to concentrate on focused areas. The program also offers four alternative paths; the general Public Health and three specialist paths of Environment and Health; Health Services and Health Promotion Management.

Students on this program come from diverse backgrounds. Many are health specialists employed at a service or policy level, while others wish to obtain public health skills that they can apply to their work in development, community services, government, research or teaching.

In public health, the main emphasis is on the health of populations and communities. There are several career options in deep research, government or public services or voluntary bodies and non-governmental organisations.

Beginning from a common core, students may grow into positions that range from health care experts, public health analysts, environmental epidemiologists, disease prevention consultants, health policy advisors or public health directors.
The annual wage of a public health specialist is approximately £78,000
Based on the educational institute and course, fees may change depending on different factors, generally, the tuition fees for a full-time international degree is £21100 annually.
All entry fees will be subject to be reviewed annually and may change without prior notice (fees are usually set for international students, for the period of the entry year).

International applicants will be required to pay an additional of £1,000 as a deposit on their tuition fees before a certificate of acceptance for studies is granted. This fee will only be refunded if immigrate visa is rejected.

Applicants are required to achieve upper second-class honours degree in a relevant degree including veterinary science, medicine, dentistry, biological sciences, pharmacy, statistics, geography, psychology politics, and social sciences.
Preference will be given to students with exceptional academic results and proven interested in public health sectors through volunteering, work experience, or research.

Typical International Baccalaureate requirements: Minimum 32 points Typical A-levels requirements: ABB International students may require to take the accredited testing system to demonstrate English proficiency. •    For IELTS: 6.0 bands overall, with no lower than 5.5 bands in every module. •    For TOEFL with an overall point of 100, including 25 in the written section

meta_description: Sports and Exercise Science pre-master degrees can provide opportunities to become exercise physiologists, coaches, fitness assistants, and local sports development officers.

h3: Introduction to Sports and Exercise Science

content: Sports and Exercise Science is a scientific method to enhance athletic performance. This includes psychology, nutrition science, physiology, and performance analysis. Several UK universities deliver courses that integrate the new medicine and educational practice, in both philosophy and technology.

Sports and Exercise Science courses in UK universities invite guest seminars from business experts, professional team placements, and a chance to attend special conferences. The demand for sports scientists has never been higher, as many sports come up against a technical revolution that demands athletes to know more about their bodies inside out and be in constant peak condition.
Having invented and developed rules for Rugby, Football, Cricket, and several others, the United Kingdom is in a unique place to be able to teach the science and methods behind the sport.

Sports and Exercise Science degrees can provide opportunities to become exercise physiologists, coaches, fitness assistants, and local sports development officers working on significant projects supported by governing bodies, sports teams, and government initiatives.

There are several career opportunities in research and teaching. Upon graduating, students can continue their professional studies by working with the British Association of Sport and Exercise Science accreditation as a sports and exercise scientist. Graduates can study to become sports rehabilitators or physiotherapists.

The department is a highly respected and renowned center of excellence in teaching and research by academics, which also represents the great interest of prospective students of different nationalities.
Entry requirements can vary depending on the university and the course you want to opt for. Here are some other requirements needed:
International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 34 points A-level Requirement: BB IELTS requirement: 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 bands in each module

The full-time regular tuition fee for an international student is £ 12,350 per annum. A timely discount on payment is available if you pay the full Year 1 charge prior to or upon registration. Special sports scholarships are available if you qualify for it.
